story_type: cargo plane fires defensive flares at sunset
hook: A cargo plane fires burning flares out of both sides.
narration: This C-130 Hercules is spitting out burning flares from both sides at once.
It belongs to the Wyoming Air National Guard's 153rd Airlift Wing, flying over Camp Guernsey.
A flare burns hotter than the plane's engines, so a heat-seeking missile chases the flare instead of the aircraft.
The crew fired them in bursts, then rolled the big plane into a hard bank.
It was a training mission, flown at sunset on September twenty-fourth, twenty nineteen.
outcome: Then the Hercules flew on into the sunset over Camp Guernsey.
title: C-130 fires a wall of flares at sunset
description:
A C-130 Hercules from the Wyoming Air National Guard's 153rd Airlift Wing fires flares over Camp Guernsey Joint Training Center during a training mission on Sept. 24, 2019.
